entries.title: Meridale customer data access restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ personnel in the United States or India may perform services provided Meridale customer data is accessed exclusively through Meridale-managed virtual desktops.
entries.quote: Vendor may perform Services using personnel located in the United States or India, provided Meridale customer data is accessed only through Meridale-managed virtual desktops.

relatedClauses.quote: Vendor shall provide data engineering, analytics and business intelligence services as described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOWs") executed under this Agreement.

entries.title: Most Favored Customer pricing commitment
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc and its Affiliates must ensure that rates, fees, discounts, and pricing offered to Meridale remain at least as favorable as those offered or charged to any other customer globally for substantially similar services in substantially similar volumes.
entries.quote: Vendor represents, warrants and covenants that the rates, fees, discounts and other pricing terms offered to Meridale under this Agreement are, and throughout the Term shall remain, at least as favorable as the rates, fees, discounts and pricing terms offered or charged by Vendor or any of its Affiliates to any other customer, anywhere in the world, for substantially similar services in substantially similar volumes.

relatedClauses.quote: If Vendor or any Affiliate offers or charges any other customer more favorable pricing, Vendor shall (a) notify Meridale in writing within thirty (30) days, (b) extend such pricing to Meridale effective from the date it was first offered to such other customer, and (c) promptly refund or credit any amounts paid by Meridale in excess of such pricing.
For the purposes of this Section 6, "Affiliate" means any entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with Vendor, including AtliQ Technologies Private Limited (India).

entries.title: MFN compliance audit rights
entries.summary: AtliQ must permit Meridale or an independent auditor to audit its records once per contract year on 15 business days' notice to verify MFN pricing compliance.
entries.quote: Once per contract year, on fifteen (15) business days' notice, Meridale or an independent auditor bound by confidentiality may audit Vendor's records to the extent reasonably necessary to verify compliance with this Section 6. If an audit reveals non-compliance, Vendor shall bear the cost of the audit in addition to the remedies in Section 6.4.

relatedClauses.quote: For the purposes of this Section 6, "Affiliate" means any entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with Vendor, including AtliQ Technologies Private Limited (India).

entries.title: General and professional liability insurance
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must maintain commercial general liability insurance of $1,000,000 and professional/cyber liability insurance of $1,000,000.
entries.quote: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability of $1,000,000 and professional/cyber liability of $1,000,000.
